settings.title: 14-day window
settings.value: Return any unworn piece within 14 days of delivery.

settings.title: Exchange or refund
settings.value: Swap size, swap colour, or take a full refund — your call.

settings.title: Original condition
settings.value: Items must be unworn with original tags and packaging.

settings.title: Request
settings.body: Email us at info@stitchfit.com.pk with your order number and the reason for return.

settings.title: Pack
settings.body: Place the item back in its original packaging with the tags still attached.

settings.title: Ship
settings.body: We'll send a return label or arrange a pickup, depending on your location.

settings.title: Refund
settings.body: Once we receive and inspect the item, your refund or exchange lands within 5–7 business days.

settings.hero_subhead: Buy with confidence. If a piece doesn't land right, send it back within 14 days for a swap or refund.
settings.cta_subhead: Reach out on WhatsApp for the fastest response, or drop us an email.
